_readme: runs/<BRANCH>/<tier>-<env>/tests/technical/<run>/tech-test-inputs.json - read by scripts/fe_tech_test.py. Every <...> is an OPEN point the skill asks.
environment: <ask - the DEV database where the test runs (NY_SCH: DGBOUS)>
reference_group_pk: <optional - the reference branch's group (SLB London 21462.4): its portfolio properties are the shape to create when the target has none>
raw_instrument: <optional - the RAW INSTRUMENT text; default from the instrument (depos: Loan / Depos)>
sub_product_pk: <optional - PGT_SYS.T_PGT_SUB_PRODUCT_S PK of the instrument (a portfolio property's FK_INSTRUMENT); known: depos 2.4, irs 20092.4>
raw_in_dev: <true when the RAW rows of the test date are already in the DEV environment (then no PROD extract)>
fe_jobs_run: <optional - the box-fe-jobs-agent run of this instrument, e.g. runs/NY_SCH/tier2-pre/fe-jobs/depos_20261009_1>
raw_market_data_filter: <optional - SQL condition on BOX_FE.T_BOX_RAW_MARKET_DATA_S; default FRONT_ID IN (the trades)>
quote_prices_date_column: <ask - PUBLISHDATE or SETTLEDATE: the first query of sql/20 counts both for the test date>
quote_prices_filter: <optional - an SQL condition on PGT_MRK.T_PGT_QUOTE_PRICES_S (e.g. FK_PARENT IN (...)); default: every price of the date>

bypass.join: <ask - already-left when p_Import_Deal_Data's join to BOX_TRD.T_BOX_DEAL_S is already LEFT in DEV; else give package_export>
bypass.package_export: <only when the join is not LEFT yet - BOX_FE.PKG_FE_DEAL_CALCULATION body as deployed in DEV, saved in 01-evidence/>
bypass.fk_portprop: <ask - PK of a Valid portfolio property of the branch GROUP and the instrument in DEV (BOX_ACC.T_BOX_ACCT_PORT_PROP_S: FK_BRANCH = branch_group_pk, FK_INSTRUMENT = sub_product_pk; sql/50 query 2)>
bypass.reference_accounting: <ask - DEAL_ID (each trade's own DEAL_ID, as the SLB trades) or a literal value>

extra_fields._readme: optional {column: SQL value} also set by sql/50 - the other columns p_Import_Deal_Data takes from BOX_TRD.T_BOX_DEAL_S (NULL under the bypass): FK_INSTRUMTYPE, FK_TRDSUBTYPE, FK_MICROHEDGE, FK_STRATEGY, FK_DEALTREAT, FK_ACCTDOC, UTI, NOMINAL_SETTLEMENT, COMPOUND_FREQ
